يستجديا (form X)
# يَسْتَجْدِيَا (yastajdiyā) /jas.tad͡ʒ.di.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْدَى (istajdā)
# يُسْتَجْدَيَا (yustajdayā) /jus.tad͡ʒ.da.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْدَى (istajdā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
